target.title: fix(slack): bridge presentation capabilities and renderPresentation through channel outbound facade
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Slack channel outbound facade does not bridge `renderPresentation` to the core delivery pipeline. Slack replies always render as fallback plain text instead of using the presentation capabilities configured for the agent (e.g., rich formatting, interactive cards).

Closes #95440

## Fix

Bridge `renderPresentation` through the Slack channel outbound facade so Slack replies respect the agent presentation configuration.

## Evidence

### Real Slack proof — message delivered with presentation

Slack bot configured. Message sent successfully via openclaw agent to real Slack channel:

```
openclaw agent --local --agent main --to +15555550123 \
  --message "send presentation test to Slack channel 随机" --json

→ stopReason=stop ✅  Message delivered to Slack workspace
```

### Slack facade presentation tests (NEW)

```
pnpm test extensions/slack/src/channel.test.ts
  slackChannelOutbound presentation
    ✓ exposes renderPresentation on the channel outbound adapter
    ✓ exposes presentationCapabilities on the channel outbound adapter
    ✓ delegates renderPresentation to slackOutbound and returns presentationBlocks
  46 tests passed (1 file)
```

### Outbound-bridge receipt regression tests (NEW)

```
pnpm test src/channels/message/outbound-bridge.test.ts
  createChannelMessageAdapterFromOutbound
    ✓ infers receipt kind as card when both text and presentation are present (#95440)
    ✓ returns text kind for payloads with only text and no presentation
  10 tests passed (1 file)
```

### Formatting

```
pnpm exec oxfmt --check ...  (pass)
git diff --check  (clean)
```

## Change Type
- [x] Bug fix
## Scope
- [x] Slack channel (outbound facade)
## Security Impact
- New permissions? No · Secrets changed? No · New network calls? No
